subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

I can't ________ this heat anymore.
solution:
The correct answer is **'bear'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence** 'bear'** should be used in the blank.
 
• **"Can't" **is the contraction of **"cannot,"** indicating ***an inability or lack of capability to do something.***
 
• **"Bear" **here means to endure or tolerate. In this sentence, it expresses the inability to continue enduring or tolerating the heat.
 
• So, when someone says* "I can't bear this heat anymore," *it means they have reached a point where they are finding it very difficult or impossible to tolerate or endure the high temperature any longer. They're expressing their discomfort and inability to handle the heat. 

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *I can't **bear** this heat anymore.*
